3. The predecessor of the defendant-respondents contested the suit by filing written statement. It is alleged that the plaintiff filed the suit on the basis of a fabricated amalnama. The learned Munsif, on consideration of the facts, circumstances and the evidence on record, dismissed the suit by his judgment and decree dated 10-1-1987 and 3-12-1987 respectively. Against the said judgment and decree the petitioner's predecessor preferred Title Appeal No. 38 of 1987 which was also dismissed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Shariatpur by his judgment dated 26-12-1987 and 29-12-1987 respectively. 

 4. Against that judgment and decree the predecessor of the petitioner moved the revisional application being Civil Revision No. 268 of 1988 and obtained a Rule. The Rule came up for hearing in the daily cause list dated 17-8-1999 and it was discharged for default. The petitioner then filed an application for restoration by vacating the order of discharge for default, but it was rejected because the grounds taken in the application for restoration were found to be frivolous.
